subject: Medisync POC: one-time credit uplift + 60-day sandbox extension request
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Emma Rhodes <emma.rhodes@medisync.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-14T09:18:00-04:00
Subject: Medisync POC: one-time credit uplift + 60-day sandbox extension request

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The initial POC looks promising from both sides and your engineers are getting good signal from the LLM on clinical summarization. As we discussed, your team is bumping into PLG limits for token usage and early regression testing. To keep momentum we’d like to request a one-time uplift so your team can finish the integration and run extended clinical prompts.

Summary of the ask:
- One-time free credit: equivalent to 150k token units (platform credit)
- Sandbox extension: additional 60 days on the evaluation sandbox (current trial ends 2026-09-30)

Attachments: medisync-poc-usage-report.pdf (current token consumption + error logs) — see section 2 for spike details.

If you’re good with this ask we’ll need an approval from our deal desk / execs; I’m cc’ing Laura for visibility. Also please confirm if procurement needs an SOW or a PO to formalize the extension and any billing path (pure credit vs invoice).

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm acceptance from Medisync (reply to this thread)
2) I’ll request exec signoff and route to Deal Desk with recommended terms
3) If approved I’ll send a short SOW + DocuSign link to lock the extension

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if you prefer.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[karthik.iyer@redwood.ai] | +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Dr. Emma Rhodes <emma.rhodes@medisync.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T10:12:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Medisync POC: one-time credit uplift + 60-day sandbox extension request

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear summary. We ran the usage report past our lead engineer and the spike in token usage came from longer-context EHR threads we needed to evaluate. Medisync is definitely interested in the uplift + extension. A couple quick items from procurement:
- We prefer a short SOW with the exact credit amount and extension dates rather than a change of the trial terms page.
- Procurement will need a draft SOW + invoice path (we can do PO -> net30).
- Are there any security artifacts you can attach for our infosec review? (SOC 2 scope, data retention statement, and the small questionnaire our team filled out)

I attached the security questionnaire that our legal team started — please have your security contacts fill in the missing fields or point me to the SOC 2 link. Once we have the SOW and a confirmation of the one-time credit we can route a PO.

Cheers,
Emma
Dr. Emma Rhodes | Head of ML Research, Medisync
emma.rhodes@medisync.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-16T08:07:00-04:00
Subject: Fwd: Medisync POC: one-time credit uplift + 60-day sandbox extension request

Hi Laura / Grace / Nikhil —

Forwarding the thread with Medisync. They’ve agreed in principle to proceed if we provide: (a) one-time credit of 150k token units, and (b) a 60-day sandbox extension formalized via a short SOW; procurement will issue a PO (net30).

Why I’m escalating:
- Medisync shows strong product-fit signals (clinical summarization + high integration velocity).
- They are a strategic mid-market prospect in the healthtech vertical and we expect a subscription conversion within Q1 if integration completes.
- The token spike is legitimate — see attached medisync-poc-usage-report.pdf (section 2).

Request to execs / deal desk:
- Approve one-time platform credit equivalent to 150k token units (no changes to base pricing or SLA).
- Approve 60-day sandbox extension tied to SOW DL-7812.
- Condition: credit is one-time, non-recurring; must be recorded against Deal ID DL-7812 and expire if no conversion after extension.

If you’re OK with a conditional approval I’ll draft the SOW and the DocuSign envelope; procurement wants the SOW to reference the credit amount and the net30 PO path.

Thanks — Karthik
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-18T11:33:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Medisync POC: one-time credit uplift + 60-day sandbox extension request

Karthik —

I’ve reviewed the usage report and the business ask. Given Medisync’s vertical and the likely ARR outcome, I’m comfortable approving a one-time concession with the following guardrails:

1) Approve up to 150k token credit (one-time, non-recurring).
2) Approve 60-day sandbox extension (new end date 2026-11-29) tied to SOW DL-7812.
3) Require Deal Desk to capture: (a) credit expiration clause, (b) conversion milestone (demo + integration checklist), and (c) finance flag to record as a marketing/CC brace one-off credit against closed-won revenue adjustments.
4) Legal to review and sign off on SOW; procurement PO accepted net30.

From an exec perspective this is an acceptable exception provided Deal Desk follows the guardrails. Please draft the SOW and send to me for signature. Add a row in the deals tracker and route to finance for accounting classification.

Approved — Laura

Laura Bennett | Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0114

Date: 2026-09-21T15:42:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Medisync POC: one-time credit uplift + 60-day sandbox extension request — Approved

Emma / Procurement —

Great news: Laura has approved a one-time uplift and the extension with the guardrails below. Per the approval we will:

- Apply a one-time platform credit equivalent to 150k token units (non-recurring).
- Extend the sandbox by 60 days; new end date 2026-11-29.
- Deliver a short SOW that references Deal ID DL-7812, the credit amount, credit expiration clause, and the conversion milestone checklist.

Next steps for Medisync (procurement):
1) I’ll upload the SOW draft to the deal record and send a DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123
2) Please confirm PO issuance and billing cadence (PO -> net30) once the SOW is countersigned.
3) For infosec: attached medisync-security-questionnaire.xlsx — our security lead will fill the outstanding items and I’ll provide the SOC 2 link.

Attachments: Medisync-SOW-draft.docx, medisync-security-questionnaire.xlsx

If everything looks correct I’ll pull Deal Desk into the DocuSign flow and route to finance for accounting classification. Thanks for moving quickly on this — excited to keep the momentum.

Best,
